At seeded max an Argonian shows 3 legit families at once: substrate (Hist Attunement, 4 fx), Hist broad (Hist-Sworn, 3 fx), People focus (Pillar, 4 fx) = ~11 lines, with Heal/Poison/Magic repeating across the two Hist-side families.
